description: February 24 birthday meaning: Pisces decan 1, birthday number 6, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a February 24 birthday falls in Pisces, in the first decan, with Neptune as the sign's ruler and Neptune as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 6. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Pisces is mutable and water.

sections.heading: The February 24 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Care runs deep on February 24. Twenty-four reduces to 6, traditionally the number of nurture and responsibility, and the Sun stands near five degrees of Pisces in its Neptune-ruled first decan. Interpreters describe a natural comforter: someone whose home is open, whose sympathy is real, and who may need reminding to look after themselves too.

Astronomically, February 24 puts the Sun near 5° Pisces in most years, inside the first ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Neptune. Neptune, modern ruler of Pisces, also governs the sign's first decan, from about February 19 to February 28. This is often seen as the most dreamy and boundless part of the zodiac's final sign. Natives tend to be imaginative, compassionate and highly sensitive to music, mood and meaning. They may move through the world like a sponge, absorbing atmosphere and other people's feelings. Doubled Neptune can blur practical edges and make escape tempting when life feels harsh. Creative work, spiritual practice and caring roles often give this decan a way to channel what it senses.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for February 24
paragraphs: A birthday on the 24th reduces as 2 + 4 = 6. The compound combines the 2's emotional attentiveness and the 4's reliability, feeding into the 6's devotion to home and community. Those born on this day are often described as dependable carers: the one who brings soup, fixes the shelf and remembers what you said last month. Stability in family life tends to matter a great deal to them. As a secondary number, the 24 points towards a gift for creating safe, well-run spaces. Accepting help in return is often their quiet area of growth.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a February 24 birthday gives Life Path 9 for 1990, 1 for 2000, 11 for 2010 and 3 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous February 24 birthdays
paragraphs: February birthdays land in late winter for the northern hemisphere, when the light is visibly returning, and in late summer for the southern. The month moves from Aquarius into Pisces around February 18 or 19, from airy idealism to watery imagination. February is month 2 in numerology, a number of partnership, tact and sensitivity, which tends to give these birthdays a cooperative, quietly perceptive undertone. February 24 is the 55th day of the year. Counting forward, the next sign change, into Aries, is usually complete within 26 days, by March 21.

By February 24 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a February 24 birthday are Steve Jobs (1955), Judith Butler (1956) and Yuval Noah Harari (1976).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is February 24?
faq.answer: February 24 is Pisces in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Pisces, which tradition links with Neptune.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on February 24?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On February 24 the Life Path is 6 in 1960, 7 in 1970, 8 in 1980, 9 in 1990, 1 in 2000, 11 in 2010 and 3 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 6 for everyone born on the 24th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on February 24?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by February 24, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on February 24?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on February 24 include Steve Jobs (1955), Judith Butler (1956) and Yuval Noah Harari (1976). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
